audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Neeko level 1 and level 6 and gave Cho'Gath levels 3 and 2+ items. The matchup's own whys say the opposite at five of seven rows: level 1 is 'a neutral last-hit stage', level 3 is 'still her window', level 6 is where Feast flips it to you, and at two items 'the lane stays even because she farms relevance off picks'.
audit.why: Neeko's pressure is Tangle-Barbs (12s at rank 1, 1000 range) and Blooming Burst; neither exists at level 1. Cho'Gath's flip is Feast at 6, not level 3, because at 3 he is still a slow melee who has to walk into 1000-range root to use a 950-range Rupture.
audit.corrected: Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill — which is exactly the packet chart. Proposed as one atomic group across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side+rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase text claimed 'levels 2-3 (full pattern)' and Heartsteel as Cho'Gath spikes and described level 6 as 'Feast stacks turn you into terrain'.
audit.why: The real spike is level 6 as a kill threat, not as bulk: Feast is true damage on a squishy frame with no built-in escape once Feral Scream is on her. Her spikes are Tangle-Barbs at 2 and Pop Blossom (120/105/90s) as a pick tool, not as a duel tool.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to that timeline.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. Wrong: the text says four times that Blooming Burst 'out-ranges your Rupture'. Riot's data gives Blooming Burst 800 range and Rupture 950 — Cho'Gath out-ranges her, he just cannot walk into 1000-range Tangle-Barbs to use it. Missing: Inherent Glamour breaks on immobilizing crowd control, so a Rupture knockup rips a disguised Neeko out of hiding; and Tangle-Barbs becomes larger, faster and roots for longer after passing through a champion or killing a unit, so a dying minion in front of you upgrades the root that hits you.
audit.why: The range claim changes how the player positions in the poke war — the honest reason to stay back is her root's reach, not her Q's. The disguise interaction is the whole answer to her pick pattern and was nowhere in the text.
audit.corrected: Range corrected in whys[1], spikes[0].text, early and breakdown.early; disguise interaction written into report[5].t and late; the Tangle-Barbs upgrade written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was placeholder text with no numbers.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs at 12s and Pop Blossom at 120s are the two clocks; Feral Scream at 11s rank 1 is the one you spend against them.
Packet flagged 'Her Blooming Burst' and "Feral Scream's" as suspect names. Both are the correct names with an ordinary English word attached — false positives, recorded so they are not chased again.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Identify how Neeko contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you has a threat at 1 — she has no clone and no root online yet, so this is a neutral last-hit stage. Farm with Vorpal Spikes.

edits.before: W silence starts flipping his combo windows. Only take the trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs is up: 12s at rank 1 and 1000 range, so any step-up gets rooted. The poke window is hers.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Neeko must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Still hers — you are slow and melee, and her 1000-range root punishes exactly the walk-up your Rupture wind-up needs.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Carnivore sustain plus Vorpal Spikes waveclear heals back her Q chip and levels the lane out as you approach your combo spike at 6.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast is true damage her resistances cannot touch, and Feral Scream's silence locks out Tangle-Barbs and Pop Blossom — bait the root, then commit.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Tangle-Barbs's cooldown.
edits.after: Your tank components out-last her mana-hungry Q poke — now you simply walk her down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Neeko carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You own the 1v1, but a clone disguise into Pop Blossom (120s at rank 1) makes her a pick threat — the map stays even.

edits.before: Q under Neeko's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Rupture as she steps up to poke, Feral Scream so Tangle-Barbs cannot answer, then E-spike out — Carnivore eats her chip.

edits.before: Whiffing Q and fighting anyway — without the knockup your kit is a slow zone with no teeth.
edits.after: Throwing Rupture at range for her to sidestep, then eating a free 12s Tangle-Barbs root.

edits.before: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 12s at rank 1, 1000 range, and it upgrades on anything it passes through. Sidestep it.

edits.before: Q under Neeko's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Rupture out-ranges Blooming Burst — 950 against 800 — so answer her poke from the edge instead of walking into root range.

edits.before: Neeko wastes Tangle-Barbs — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: The silence locks out both Tangle-Barbs and Pop Blossom at once.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream is 11s at rank 1 — spend it on her root, not on chip.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1, 1000 range, and it grows larger, faster and longer-rooting once it passes through a champion or kills a unit — never stand behind a dying minion. - Pop Blossom: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Respect Neeko's Tangle-Barbs completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Last-hit at max range and eat the chip. Rupture reaches 950 against Blooming Burst's 800, so you can answer her poke — you just cannot walk into 1000-range Tangle-Barbs to do it.

edits.before: Track Neeko's Tangle-Barbs: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-knockup + Feast the kill.
edits.after: Immobilizing CC breaks Inherent Glamour, so a Rupture knockup rips a disguised Neeko straight out of hiding.

edits.before: Her Blooming Burst (Q) out-ranges your Rupture and Tangle-Barbs (E) roots you on any step-up, so she pokes you for free before your level-3 combo exists.
edits.after: Blooming Burst (Q) chips you from 800 and Tangle-Barbs (E) roots any step-up from 1000, so she pokes for free long before your level-3 combo exists.

edits.before: Neeko's window: Blooming Burst (Q) pokes you from outside Rupture range and her Tangle-Barbs (E) roots you if you walk up, so she chips your health while you can only farm and wait for your level-3 Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo.
edits.after: Neeko's window: Tangle-Barbs (E) reaches 1000 and roots any step-up, so even though your Rupture out-ranges Blooming Burst by 950 to 800, you cannot safely commit until your level-3 Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo lands.

edits.before: Poke you with Blooming Burst (Q) from range and root you with Tangle-Barbs (E) if you over-step, chipping you while you are stuck farming pre-3
edits.after: Poke with Blooming Burst (Q) at 800 and root you with Tangle-Barbs (E) from 1000 if you over-step, chipping you while you farm pre-3

notes: The FULL layer refers to Neeko as 'he' in several places I did not touch (breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].t, report[11], report[12]). Those are champion-level pronoun errors rather than facts; several are under 25 characters or would need a rewrite outside the length band, so they need a manual sweep. NOT ASSERTED: whether a Rupture knockup interrupts Pop Blossom during its preparation window — Riot's text says the leap follows 'a short preparation' but does not say the preparation is interruptible, and needsResearch.animationCancels is null for both champions. Also not asserted: whether Tangle-Barbs or Pop Blossom's stun is reduced by tenacity, or whether her clone can be hit by Feast. Cho'Gath's kit file flags Rupture as 'grounding' while Riot's description says it pops enemies into the air — I treated it as a knockup only, which also matters here because Pop Blossom carries a 'dash' flag that a grounding claim would have invited me to counter.
